rotation_policy: Use only the user-approved canonical subject order. Start the current cycle at Data Center Technician, then Data Center Engineering, and continue through the listed tracks. Network Technician and Network Engineering are separate tracks. Existing archived lessons remain authoritative history. Before publishing, reconcile the candidate against live WordPress and the applicable archives; if that lesson is already published, skip it and continue to the next clean canonical slot rather than duplicating it. One lesson teaches one focused concept. Every published lesson must be verified live and archived identically to BitcoinVersus, TechCert, and OpenCert before the rotation advances. Subjects not listed in rotation remain available as archive/history but are not part of the canonical lesson rotation unless the user explicitly adds them. Every published item requires at least one directly relevant verified playable native Gutenberg YouTube embed; substantial or longer lessons should use at least two distinct YouTube videos when both materially improve the lesson. Substantial or longer lessons should also include directly relevant social-media sources when suitable sources exist. Never advance while a required media embed is broken. Do not number paragraphs or section headings; use descriptive headings only.
